releaseNotes.headline: Fix macOS launch permissions

highlights.detail: The packaged app preserves executable permissions so macOS can launch usAIge after installation.
highlights.title: Corrected installer

highlights.detail: Fresh, validated local Claude usage responses still supply exact reset timestamps without a network request.
